title: 诊断卷 #1 · 时态 / 语态 / 主谓一致
topic: IELTS 写作 Task 1 & 阅读话题语境
goal: 定位你在时态、语态、主谓一致、非谓语动词上的薄弱点，作为后续针对性练习的起点。预计用时 10 分钟。

passages.title: Bike-sharing in European cities
passages.body: Many cities around the world have introduced bike-sharing schemes to reduce traffic congestion. In Paris, the Vélib' system, launched in 2007, now operates more than 20,000 bicycles. Although the scheme is widely seen as a success, critics point out that it mainly benefits tourists and short-term visitors rather than daily commuters. In London, a similar scheme was introduced in 2010, and by 2015 the number of journeys exceeded 10 million per year.

questions.prompt: Air pollution in major cities ___ a serious concern ___ the 1990s.
questions.explanation: since + 时间点（the 1990s）是现在完成时的标志，表示"从那时起一直到现在"；for 后面要接时间段（如 for 20 years），接时间点是错的。

questions.prompt: By the time the researchers arrived at the site, the volunteers ___ the experiment.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去时间点（arrived），表示"在那之前已经发生"，要用过去完成时 had done。

questions.prompt: The number of people working from home ___ increased dramatically since the pandemic.
questions.explanation: the number of + 名词作主语时中心词是 number（单数），谓语用单数 has；对比 a number of = many，后面谓语用复数。

questions.prompt: ___ with the same task, the two teams adopted completely different strategies.
questions.explanation: be faced with 是固定搭配（"面对"），分词作状语时直接说 Faced with...；Facing 后面不能接 with。

questions.prompt: By 2050, global sea levels ____ (rise) by more than 30 centimetres.
questions.explanation: by + 将来时间点是将来完成时 will have done 的标志：到 2050 年时"将已经上升"。

questions.prompt: Single-use plastics ____ (should / ban) in all public venues.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 + 被动语态：should + be + 过去分词。主语 plastics 是"被禁止"的对象，必须用被动。

questions.prompt: ___ number of students who prefer online courses ___ growing every year.
questions.explanation: a number of = many（许多），谓语用复数 are；the number of 强调"数量"本身，谓语用单数 is。注意题干中是 A number of students，所以选 are。

questions.prompt: 阅读短文，用括号内单词的正确形式填空（注意时态、非谓语与词形变化）。
questions.passage: Over the past decade, the way people work __1__ (change) dramatically. Many employees now prefer __2__ (work) from home, which allows them __3__ (avoid) long commutes. However, working remotely can also make people feel __4__ (isolate), and some studies suggest that face-to-face communication __5__ (be) still essential for teamwork.
questions.explanation: ①over the past decade + 现在完成时 has changed；②prefer doing / prefer to do 均可；③allow sb to do sth；④feel + 形容词（feel isolated 感到孤立）；⑤主语 communication 不可数，谓语用 is。

questions.prompt: Vélib' was the first bike-sharing scheme in the world.
questions.explanation: 原文只说巴黎 2007 年推出 Vélib'，没有说它是"世界上第一个"——信息不存在，无法判断 → NOT GIVEN。

questions.prompt: The Paris scheme was launched before the London one.
questions.explanation: 巴黎 2007 年推出，伦敦 2010 年推出，巴黎更早，与题干一致 → TRUE。

questions.prompt: According to critics, the scheme helps daily commuters more than tourists.
questions.explanation: 原文 critics 认为它"benefits tourists rather than daily commuters"（主要惠及游客而非通勤者），题干说反了 → FALSE。

questions.prompt:
Task 1 迷你练习：用不超过 3 句话描述以下趋势——2000 至 2020 年，城市私家车数量翻倍；同期公共交通使用率稳步上升，但增速放缓。
要求：① 时态用一般过去时；② 使用趋势词汇（如 double / rise steadily / growth slowed）；③ 用 while 体现对比结构。

answer.rubric: 评分要点：① 时态准确（一般过去时，无现在时串用）② 趋势词汇恰当（doubled / rose steadily / slowed）③ 有 while 对比结构 ④ 不超过 3 句

questions.knowledge_point: 写作 Task 1 趋势描述
